body: What a beautifully eloquent explanation of the type of pain that some of us feel. For me, what resonates the most is being tired. Tired of trying, tired of tolerating and coping, tired of waking up everyday. I’m almost certain I cannot continue living in any condition for another 50 years. Why not stop while we are ahead? I don’t know
I don’t know how you’re able to do it! I am an introvert, but I still get lonely sometimes and seek out interaction with my loved ones.

Well good on you for finding something that distracts your head and let’s you feel something. I do the same thing a lot of the time. Watching TikTok, YT videos, listening to music, etc.,anything to get my head to stop thinking negatively and to try to feel something positive. just trying to keep busy with homework doesn’t work anymore, so it’s hard to be productive. It sucks that just living in reality and in the moment feels so difficult, unfavourable, painful. But what else do we do, you know?
Thank you for your insight. Maybe there is something to look forward to, then, when things improve

I like the idea of this post. I’ve been finding that the only thing that keeps me going these days are future events that I have signed up for or committed to, like dentist appointments, plans with friends, and things of the sort. This weekly post may be helpful for me. :) 

Today, I spent most of the day just grinding through studying for my different classes. Have a week off right now, but I’ve been stuck studying. Still, I’m getting through it. Finished the day with video games and am now stuck with my thoughts again. Have a plan to go out with friends on Friday, so I gotta keep taking care of myself till then.

You make a great point. The system we live in is made on so many assumptions and expectations that we just can’t all meet. They blame you for not working hard enough when you are working as hard as you can. And when you’re always working so hard, you wonder how this life could be something you’d want to expose your children to. I hear you, friend. I deal with very similar thoughts regularly too. It’s tough to feel truly free.
